Every target reached. The next block starts with your next class.
Not yet: %1$s.\n\nRepeat the %2$d classes from %3$s and take this exam again? Completed days, history and skills are kept. Or keep going with the next block.
Exam saved: not every target yet. Those are tested again at the next exam.
Repeating a block before its exam
You stopped at %1$s. Today brings you through the block and its exam again, then back there. Completed days and history are kept.

A real test of your level: one fresh set of every skill family you train, at the number shown. Take it fresh, as your first class of the day. After the class you tick the targets you reached; missing the headline skill, or three or more, lets you repeat the block before moving on.
